note: Villagers now care about their gear: they want better weapons, save toward a gold goal, and buy upgrades at market stalls when they can afford them — a guard with a rusty sword will come home with a steel blade. They also sell spare gear back to stalls, but never at a cost to themselves: never their only weapon, never their last piece of armor, never the tool their job needs, and never a sale that leaves them worse equipped. Examine a villager to see what they want and what they are saving for, and watch for the ones doing well enough to enjoy the tavern life
